Deliverable: The Contractor shall provide a Microsite Content and Link Audit Report (delivered upon launch and audited quarterly, verifying all 5+ pages are live, accurate, and properly integrated with nationalguard.com infrastructure). 5.10.2 Contractor shall provide a general landing page and personalized landing pages for up to fifty (50) designated NMARNG recruiters. The Contractor shall ensure each personalized page is 100% accurate, featuring the respective recruiter's verified contact information, official photo, and specific recruiting station (RSID) details. To maintain operational readiness during personnel turnovers, the Contractor shall deploy new pages or update existing recruiter profiles within 72 business hours of receiving a formal roster update from NMARNG leadership. Deliverable: The Contractor shall provide a Quarterly Recruiter Landing Page Audit (cross-referencing the live landing pages against the official RRB manning roster to ensure 100% accuracy of deployed digital assets). 5.10.3 Contractor shall provide lead capture and tracking infrastructure across the microsite and all 50 individual recruiter landing pages.
